measured.correction_made_before_delivery: this cell's RUN_STATE.md first recorded five outstanding rows. measured.defect_found_while_wiring: subprocess.run(text=True) decodes with the locale codec (GBK here) and STATS_RULES.md is Chinese prose with U+27E8 placeholders; the gate reconfigures its own stdout to UTF-8 for exactly that reason. UnicodeDecodeError landed in subprocess's reader thread and handed the caller an empty stdout -- still a refusal, but with the wrong reason on every sealed launch. Fixed with encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'.
